name: swe
description: SWE skills for AI coding agents: an SWE router that runs a task through a step-by-step playbook, design hash-outs, short handoff plans, behavioral verification, CI triage and verified landing, and more

interface.shortDescription: A task router plus planning, implementation, review, and PR skills for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: The playbook router ($swe:playbook <task> in Codex, /swe:playbook <task> in Claude Code) matches a task to a step-by-step playbook and tracks every step. Portable skills for planning, implementing, reviewing, and publishing code changes, plus a daedalus agent for bounded implementation tasks and a review brief for native reviewers, with short handoff plans and session handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Help me decide how to design this.
